# Language Compatibility

| Language | Chimera quantum role |
|---|---|
| C | stable ABI boundary |
| C++ | native baseline simulator |
| Rust | native research implementation |
| Python | reference simulator + optional ecosystem adapters |
| Java | portable data-model adapter |
| C# | portable data-model adapter |
| TypeScript | web data-model adapter |
| Kotlin | Android/mobile adapter |
| Swift | Apple adapter |
| Dart | Flutter/mobile adapter |

All language implementations use the same versioned circuit/result concepts.
